In 1970, there were only about 10,000 people living in Copperas Cove and some of them built this house. It really is the perfectly modest home with everything you need to live that peaceful, small town life. You're in walking distance from one of the best Italian restaurants in town. There's a classy little wine bar around the corner and two auto parts stores, a muffler shop, and another mechanic if you're thinking about customizing a car under the carport. There are two bedrooms, a little kitchen open to the living room, and it all sits on a big corner lot making for the coolest space to entertain friends and family any time of year.
